name: Stream Bridge
author: Fraser Simpson
description: Resolve tracks through a configured Eclipse Music add-on and play its stream in Orpheon's local player.

actions.name: audio.source
actions.why: Finds the requested recording through your Eclipse Music add-on and returns its playable audio stream.

actions.name: network
actions.why: Connects to the Eclipse add-on you choose, which may be hosted on any public HTTPS domain.

actions.name: settings.page
actions.why: Lets you configure the Eclipse add-on URL used to resolve and stream tracks.

settings.label: Eclipse add-on URL
settings.description: Paste the add-on manifest URL, including any token path. Example: https://host.example/token/manifest.json
